subject: Mythology
title: Mythology as Political Propaganda
description: A quick win: understand Mythology as Political Propaganda.

hook.text: Roman emperors claimed descent from Venus. British kings claimed descent from Troy. Myths are power tools.

buildup.text: Augustus used the Aeneid to prove Rome was destined by the gods. Mythology legitimized his rule over millions.

discovery.text: The Nazis twisted Norse mythology to justify racial supremacy, ruining runes and Viking symbols for generations.

twist.text: Modern nations still use founding myths. Every country has an origin story that is part history, part mythology.

climax.text: National myths shape identity, inspire patriotism, and sometimes justify terrible things — all at the same time.

punchline.text: Whoever controls the myth controls who feels powerful and who does not.

quiz.question: How did the Nazis misuse mythology?
options: They funded archaeological digs to discover the truth about ancient myths
They twisted Norse mythology and runic symbols to justify racial supremacy
They banned all mythology from schools and public life
